target: Cross-family transfer of binary event-relation distinctions under held-out grammar constructions, not memorization or natural language generalization. No claims about raw JSON.
scope: 90 candidate structural slots, not 90 independently accepted families. A predicate pair is a proposed lexical/grammatical mapping, not asserted logical equivalence. Especially modal, conditional, deontic, factive, report and incompatibility constructions need semantic verification; reject those that do not preserve directional requires/prevents and their exact negations. No extra event markers. No texts, model evaluation or diagnostic fitting.

rules.identity: HOLD type does not create a new known-relation family. Merge same/semantically equivalent known construction signature even if HOLD differs. Coarse structural cluster IDs are preliminary conservative flags, not independent semantic proof. Four-field equality => structural conflict, 3 of 4 => review; identical known-side construction or equivalent frame => merge irrespective of HOLD. Surface dedup remains screening; exact text duplicates prohibited as v3.
rules.split: Provisional 10 TRAIN/5 EVAL per stratum by Fisher-Yates xorshift32 seed381801; not approved; cluster collisions spanning split invalidate provisional split. No final corpus split until semantic review. Independent review and final roster manifest required.
rules.hold: Distinct proposed fine-grained HOLD vocab categories by split; semantically related broad categories may overlap and need audit (e.g. temporal ordering). No causal words automatically treated HOLD if entail known relation. Review true unsupported labels and no lexical shortcut; two types per family; matched grammar/length; separate novelty metric. No final claims of disjoint semantic HOLD types.
rules.review: Review all 90 structures, all 8 counterfactual labels and 2 HOLD labels after lawful realization, but before fitting. First review structural roster before text generation. If merged/invalid clusters <90 or independent reviewer unavailable, HOLD. Do not reduce polarity or denominator automatically; narrower domain requires separate precommit and new review.
